_doc: Catalyst category metadata for scoring. Probability/magnitude/time are TYPICAL values; the skill should adjust per-case based on Stage 5 evidence.

categories.name: Margin expansion realized
categories.evidence_required: Management guided margin path, quarterly evidence of progress, or input cost relief documented

categories.name: Upward guidance reset
categories.evidence_required: Analyst day, pre-announcement, mid-quarter operating data

categories.name: First beat after multiple misses (PEAD)
categories.evidence_required: 2+ consecutive prior misses, latest quarter beats EPS+revenue with guidance raise
categories.surprising_note: Strongest PEAD signal is the SECOND beat after credibility nadir, not the first

categories.name: Buyback initiated or accelerated
categories.evidence_required: Buyback authorization size > 5% of market cap, history of executing on prior authorizations

categories.name: Spinoff announced (Greenblatt-quality filter)
categories.evidence_required: Form 10 filed + 5 Greenblatt criteria (mgmt alignment, small relative size, clean balance sheet, sector orphan, Days 10-45 entry)

categories.name: New CEO with relevant track record
categories.evidence_required: Prior CEO record at peer company, alignment package, articulated 100-day plan

categories.name: New CFO (especially from higher-quality peer)
categories.evidence_required: 8-K announcement, prior employer quality, no concurrent restatement
categories.surprising_note: Often underweighted by markets — CFO has highest informational granularity

categories.name: 13D from top-tier activist + thesis confirmed
categories.evidence_required: Filer in {Pershing Square, Elliott, Trian, Starboard, ValueAct, Engaged Capital, JANA}, public letter or board pursuit, independent analysis confirms

categories.name: 'Exploring strategic alternatives' announced
categories.evidence_required: 8-K with exact 'exploring strategic alternatives' language, banker hired, no anti-shareholder defenses (poison pill, dual-class entrenchment)

categories.name: FDA approval (binary)
categories.evidence_required: Phase III data, PDUFA date in 6 months, no FDA red flags

categories.name: Patent litigation favorable settlement / win
categories.evidence_required: Strong IP position, comparable case outcomes

categories.name: New product launch with significant revenue ramp
categories.evidence_required: Launch date set, pre-order or pipeline data, comparable past launches successful

categories.name: Major capacity coming online (e.g. new fab, plant, AI data center)
categories.evidence_required: Capex schedule, customer commitments, no major delays in last 12 months

categories.name: Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski opportunistic insider cluster buying
categories.evidence_required: 3+ unique insiders, Code P only, outside historical pattern, rolling 90-day window, CEO/CFO weighted highest

categories.name: S&P 500 deletion (fundamentals intact)
categories.evidence_required: Deletion announced/effective in last 30 days, business operations unimpaired, liquidity not permanently damaged
categories.surprising_note: Index INCLUSION as buy signal is DEAD (Greenwood-Sammon-Thesmar 2022). Only DELETION creates opportunity.

categories.name: Rate cut cycle beneficiary (long duration / leveraged)
categories.evidence_required: Rate cuts priced in / underway, sector mechanically benefits (REITs, utilities, high-leverage)

categories.name: Commodity cycle recovery (energy/materials)
categories.evidence_required: Inventory drawdown observable, capex cuts widespread industry, demand stable

anti_patterns: Catalyst with no named event AND no date range = hopium
'The story will play out' without quantifiable trigger = reject
'Twitter / forum hype' is NOT a catalyst
Double-counting: buyback + dividend + earnings beat from same earnings report = ONE catalyst, not three
